qualifier: resolvins, protectins and maresins from non-arachidonate PUFAs
name: Resolvin, protectin and maresin biosynthesis
rationale: All members synthesize resolvins, protectins, maresins or related oxo-derivatives from EPA, DHA and DPA, whereas the confusables cover arachidonate-derived lipoxins, HETEs and leukotriene catabolism.

core: Oncogenic receptor tyrosine kinase variant signaling
name: Oncogenic FGFR and ALK/LTK receptor kinase variant signaling
rationale: All members are signaling by cancer-associated fusions, amplifications or mutants of receptor tyrosine kinases, dominated by FGFR1-3 plus ALK/LTK, whereas the confusables center on EGFR/ERBB2 mutants, PDGFRA point mutants, cytosolic fusions or ALK drug-resistance mutants.

name: Stress granule dynamics and mRNA stabilization
rationale: Members cover stress granule assembly, disassembly and arsenite/PKR stress responses together with IGF2BP/CRD-mediated mRNA stabilization and translation, while confusables carry only one half and add mRNA destabilization and decay.

core: DNA excision repair and translesion synthesis
qualifier: with nucleobase deamination and editing, not double-strand break repair
name: Excision repair, translesion synthesis and nucleobase deamination
rationale: Members span base excision, nucleotide excision and mismatch repair, translesion synthesis, damage reversal and cytidine/adenosine deamination (APOBEC, editing, somatic hypermutation), whereas the confusables are dominated by double-strand break, homologous recombination, NHEJ and telomere repair.

core: Negative regulation of alpha-beta T cell responses
name: Suppression of alpha-beta T cell activation and IFN-gamma production
rationale: All three members negatively regulate CD4/CD8 alpha-beta T cell activation or proliferation or type II interferon output, whereas confusables concern IL-2/IL-21/IL-6 suppression, positive T cell proliferation, dendritic cell control or T helper/Treg differentiation.

qualifier: with retinal vasculature and blood-retinal barrier
name: Eye morphogenesis and retinal vascular barrier development
rationale: Members cover retina, lens, cornea, iris, eyelid and optic nerve morphogenesis together with hyaloid regression, retinal vessel formation and blood-retinal/brain barrier establishment, whereas confusables focus on photoreceptor and retinal neuron differentiation, lens/lacrimal development or phototransduction and retinoid metabolism.

name: Alpha-2 adrenergic Gi/Gz adenylate cyclase inhibition
rationale: All members describe inhibitory G protein (Gi/Gz) suppression of adenylate cyclase, anchored on alpha-2 adrenergic receptor signaling, whereas confusables cover general cAMP turnover and calcium signaling, muscarinic/serotonin receptors, or adrenaline effects on secretion.

qualifier: activation, recovery and light detection without opsin defects
name: Phototransduction cascade activation and recovery
rationale: Members cover activation, inactivation and regulation of the phototransduction cascade, light detection and the SLC24A1 night-blindness defect, whereas confusables center on opsins and cone opsin defects, the retinoid cycle, or photoreceptor development.

qualifier: with TGF-beta receptor and SMAD cancer mutants
name: Mismatch repair and TGF-beta receptor/SMAD cancer mutants
rationale: Members combine MutS/MutL mismatch repair and its defects with cancer mutants of TGFBR1/2, SMAD2/3/4 and TCF7L2, the microsatellite-instability axis, whereas confusables pair the TGF-beta mutants with RUNX3/Hippo or TGFBR3, or the mismatch repair set with base excision repair or immunoglobulin diversification.

qualifier: kainate and AMPA receptors with receptor clustering
name: Kainate/AMPA receptor transmission and synaptic receptor clustering
rationale: Members cover kainate and AMPA receptor activation, excitatory transmission, presynaptic G-protein modulation and glutamate receptor clustering/diffusion trapping, whereas confusables add nicotinic receptors, NMDA receptor signaling and LTP, or broader presynaptic secretion control without receptor clustering.

qualifier: capping, severing and bundling rather than Rho GTPase signaling
name: Actin filament capping, severing and bundling
rationale: Members concern actin filament capping, severing, depolymerization, crosslinking and network/bundle assembly with focal adhesion IPP components, whereas confusables are dominated by Rho-family GTPase cycles and protrusion (lamellipodium, filopodium, ruffle) assembly.

core: Planar cell polarity and convergent extension
qualifier: neural plate and axial midline (notochord, floor plate)
name: Planar polarity in neural plate and axial midline morphogenesis
rationale: Members combine planar cell polarity/WNT5A non-canonical signaling and convergent extension with neural plate, notochord, axial mesoderm and floor plate formation, whereas confusables add Wnt/calcium signaling, Wnt secretion, Hedgehog/GLI or left-right asymmetry instead of axial midline development.

name: Fructose catabolism and gluconeogenesis via alanine and oxaloacetate
rationale: Members cover fructose catabolism and its inborn errors together with gluconeogenesis and alanine/oxaloacetate metabolism, whereas confusables concern glucokinase/glycogen and glucose-6-phosphatase disorders or alditol and glycerol metabolism.

name: Macrophage anti-protozoan defense and anti-inflammatory response
rationale: Members span leishmania and protozoan responses, GBP host defense, NADPH oxidase activation, anthrax toxin uptake and CD163/FCGR3A/ADORA2B anti-inflammatory IL-10 signaling, whereas confusables emphasize mycobacterial manipulation of host cells, bacterial toxins, or neutrophil respiratory burst and tissue-macrophage programs.

name: Myeloid and erythro-megakaryocytic hematopoietic differentiation
rationale: Members cover HSC maintenance, RUNX1-driven programs and differentiation of monocytes/macrophages, granulocytes, mast cells, erythrocytes and megakaryocytes with CSF signaling, whereas confusables center on cytokine JAK-STAT receptor signaling or B and T lymphocyte development and activation.

name: Glucose-6-phosphate transport and hydrolysis disorders
rationale: All members concern the ER glucose-6-phosphatase system (G6PC, G6PC3 and the SLC37A4 hexose-phosphate transporter) and its deficiency diseases, whereas confusables cover fructose/gluconeogenesis, glycogen synthesis and breakdown, glycolysis or glucokinase regulation.

name: Insulin, glucagon and glucose-sensing control of fuel metabolism
rationale: Members cover insulin receptor/AKT2/GLUT4 and glucagon/PKA signaling over glycogen, gluconeogenesis and triglyceride breakdown plus ChREBP and carbon-catabolite glucose-responsive transcription, whereas confusables focus on beta-cell insulin secretion, insulin signaling alone, fructose bisphosphate glycolytic control or LXR lipid genes.

core: Transcriptional control of lipid metabolism and adipogenesis
name: Adipogenesis and PPAR/SREBP/LXR control of lipid metabolism
rationale: Members span white/brown/beige adipocyte differentiation and nutrient-responsive transcription (PPAR, SREBP, LXR, ChREBP, PGC-1alpha, circadian factors) over lipid, cholesterol and glucose metabolism, whereas confusables emphasize insulin/glucagon signaling, glucose-sensing alone, or thermogenesis and fatty acid transport.

qualifier: lipoylated 2-oxoacid dehydrogenases and Fe-S cluster assembly
name: TCA cycle with lipoylated 2-oxoacid dehydrogenases and Fe-S clusters
rationale: Members cover TCA cycle intermediates, PDH/OGDH/OADH complexes with protein lipoylation and DLD defects, lysine and glycine catabolism, and Fe-S cluster assembly for TCA enzymes, whereas confusables add coenzyme A/pantothenate synthesis and PDH regulation or vitamin B6 and serine metabolism.

name: Bone and tooth mineralization and odontogenesis
rationale: Members cover regulation of bone, enamel, dentin and cementum mineralization, odontoblast and tooth development, with PTH and FGF23-Klotho phosphate signaling, whereas confusables focus on osteoclast-driven bone resorption or sodium-phosphate transport and its disorders.

name: Lagging-strand DNA synthesis including telomere C-strand fill-in
rationale: All members describe primer synthesis, polymerase switching, strand elongation and flap removal of lagging-strand replication, including at the telomere C-strand, whereas confusables add translesion synthesis, nucleotide excision repair or base excision repair gap filling.

name: Intestinal absorptive epithelium and HNF4-driven endodermal identity
rationale: Members are dominated by HNF4/CDX-specified intestinal and hepatic absorptive epithelium programs, intestinal stem cell and epithelial maintenance, plus pancreatic ductal/endocrine lineage and columnar epithelial maturation, whereas confusables cover early endoderm and pancreatic progenitor specification, lung epithelium, or antimicrobial defensin programs.

qualifier: oxidative stress and ligand-deprivation (dependence receptor) signaling
name: Apoptosis control under oxidative stress and ligand deprivation
rationale: Members regulate hydrogen peroxide-, oxidative stress- and hypoxia-induced intrinsic apoptosis together with extrinsic apoptosis triggered in the absence of ligand, whereas confusables cover broader peroxide, nitrosative or hyperoxic stress responses and ferroptosis without the ligand-deprivation arm.

core: Host-pathogen interaction at the host cell
name: Host-pathogen interaction via bacterial invasion and toxin uptake
rationale: Members combine bacterial attachment and entry (Listeria InlA, Gram-positive response, actin-based motility) with uptake of diphtheria and anthrax toxins and macrophage host responses, whereas confusables lack the invasion arm (macrophage anti-inflammatory/anti-protozoan sets) or emphasize mycobacterial phagosome manipulation.

name: Cell-cycle DNA replication initiation and replication stress checkpoint
rationale: Members cover initiation and regulation of mitotic/nuclear DNA replication with E2F1 targets and ATR-mediated replication checkpoint signaling, whereas confusables focus on pre-replicative complex assembly, DNA unwinding and break-induced replication, or broader E2F cell-cycle programs.
